cumulative.notes: Oman maintained neutrality but was directly struck. 16 drones recorded total per Wikipedia. 3 killed (2 expats in Sohar 13 Mar, 1 tanker crew 2 Mar), 15 injured (1 Duqm worker 1 Mar, 4 Khasab tanker crew 1 Mar, 10 Sohar 13 Mar). No verified strikes after 13 Mar. US Embassy alerts continued through 23 Mar. Iran denied ordering strikes on Oman.

daily.label: 28 Feb
daily.events: Iranian drones detected transiting Omani airspace en route to UAE. All 5 intercepted by Royal Air Force of Oman.

daily.label: 1 Mar
daily.events: Missile overflight intercepted. Oman issues statement affirming territorial sovereignty and neutrality.

daily.label: 2 Mar
daily.events: Omani diplomatic channels active for ceasefire negotiations. Continued drone overflights intercepted.

daily.label: 3 Mar
daily.events: Sultan Haitham bin Tariq speaks with multiple heads of state. RAFO intercepts 3 drones and 1 ballistic trajectory over Musandam.

daily.label: 4 Mar
daily.events: Drone overflights continue. Oman coordinates with GCC partners on airspace monitoring.

daily.label: 5 Mar
daily.events: Reduced overflight activity. Oman hosts back-channel diplomatic meeting in Muscat.

daily.label: 6 Mar
daily.events: Spike in overflights as Iran escalates. RAFO intercepts missile trajectory near Sohar.

daily.label: 8 Mar
daily.events: Reduced activity as ceasefire talks gain traction through Omani mediation.

daily.label: 9 Mar
daily.events: Low-level drone overflights continue. Oman ceasefire proposal under consideration.

daily.label: 10 Mar
daily.events: Minimal overflight activity. Oman continues diplomatic mediation efforts.

daily.label: 11 Mar
daily.events: Salalah Port targeted — drones set 2 fuel tanks on fire, port operations suspended. 1 drone intercepted north of Duqm. No casualties. Source: Al Jazeera, Times of Oman, GCC condemnation statement.

daily.label: 12 Mar
daily.events: Drone downed in Khasab Governorate airspace. No human or material losses. Source: Times of Oman.

daily.label: 13 Mar
daily.events: 2 drones hit Sohar province. One struck al-Awahi Industrial Area — 2 expats killed, 10 injured. Second fell in open area, no casualties. US State Dept ordered non-essential staff departure. Source: Al Jazeera, Times of Oman, Middle East Eye.
